## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] `go test ./...`
- [ ] `go vet ./...`
- [ ] Platform/build checks or reason not applicable
- [ ] Documentation/CLI examples updated
- [ ] Compatibility and data migration impact considered
- [ ] Security/ACL impact considered

## Notes

Include screenshots or reproducible CLI logs when changing the UI or network flows. Do not include credentials or private user data.
